correctness.rationale: The exact discrete-time absorbing birth–death Green kernel is checked by its boundary values, harmonicity, and unit jump, with update-stay factors preserved. The exponentially separated endpoint scale weights yield the uniformly valid denominator; the funded threshold state dominates the expected cost with the claimed exact prefactor; finite-reward and full-invest regimes follow directly from the same formula. The complete included verify.py executed successfully (510 exact rational comparisons and 54 high-precision asymptotic checks). Finite tests corroborate, but do not prove, the analytic estimates.

value.rationale: For every genuinely partial cutoff this derives a new model-motivated sharp expected-budget exponent, exact prefactor and competition between two physical escape barriers. It distinguishes finite from exponential costs and exposes a logistic incentive transition. The cutoff-general question is explicitly left analytically difficult in the source, and this answers a natural uniform strong-selection class without requiring a downstream theorem.
